title: Reopen an exact historical board after newer publication
preconditions: Disposable board erd b1 pins jobs ERD r1 with Original detail; retain its rendered SVG and exact child pins.

steps.action: Revise jobs to r2 with New detail and reload unchanged board b1.
steps.expected_result: The existing board does not follow the newer child revision.

steps.action: Publish board b2 using jobs r2, then resolve exact b1.
steps.expected_result: Historical b1 renders identical SVG to its original content and its original source pins remain intact.

expected_result: Historical b1 renders identical SVG to its original content and its original source pins remain intact.
